purpose: Teach: 俊輔/ノブ/ひで/裕子/京子/千尋/貞/みゆき

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の俊輔くんとご来店だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer came in with her grandson Shusuke the other day.
lines.style: Warm recollection, sharing a detail like you noticed something small and kind about someone. Gentle pace, almost conversational. Soft fondness in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人のノブさんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was here having tea with her friend Nobu.
lines.style: Observing a moment in passing. Quiet, noticing tone. Light and unforced, like mentioning something you caught in the corner of your eye. No emphasis.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人のひでさんとお話しされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was talking with her friend Hide.
lines.style: Soft observation, no weight behind it. Speaking at ease, remembering a small detail. Natural rhythm, like you're thinking out loud but kindly. Slight trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お友達の裕子さんとご来店だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer came in with her friend Yuko.
lines.style: Continuing the thread of warm noticing. Gentle and easy. Slight smile in the voice without forcing it. Measured, like tending to something small and real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お母様のお名前が京子さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's mother is named Kyoko.
lines.style: Thoughtful detail-sharing. Soft curiosity about the human behind the order. Not intrusive—just noticing and tucking that away. Quiet, present tone. Natural pacing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、姪御さんの千尋ちゃんを連れていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer brought her niece Chihiro with her.
lines.style: Light recollection, the kindness of noticing a child. Warm but understated. Even pace, genuine fondness. The voice of someone who sees people, not just transactions.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「貞操、つまり貞の意義」のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer shared something about the meaning of integrity with us.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Respect for what was shared. Slower, more careful pace. The tone of someone holding onto a moment that mattered. Soft, sincere closing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お友達のみゆきさんと打ち合わせされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was here meeting with her friend Miyuki.
lines.style: Gentle observation winding down. Quiet, knowing tone. No rush. The ease of someone who has been listening and watching all along. Soft, natural fadeout.
